district_name: Northern Mountain Valley Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(A) inventory: Northern Mountain Valley Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Franklin Northeast Supervisory Union (member towns: Bakersfield, Berkshire, Montgomery, Sheldon). Operates the four town elementary schools; secondary students attend Enosburgh-Richford UUSD schools.

board.org_name: Northern Mountain Valley Unified Union School Board

sources.note: Northern Mountain Valley UUSD: eight directors, residency allocated two per member town (Bakersfield, Berkshire, Montgomery, Sheldon), elected by the whole district electorate on one Australian ballot (modified at-large, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) pattern; the district's warnings and official ballots say so in form). Term ends are minted only for the three March 2025 ballot winners; the five continuing members carry no end (none published). NMV UUSD official ballot, March 4, 2025 (Sheldon sample ballot, official): one district ballot electing "One (1) school director for a three-year term, ending March 2028, who resides in the Town of Bakersfield" (Audrey Shea), "One (1) school director for the remaining two years of a three-year term, ending March 2027, who resides in the Town of Montgomery" (Michelle Schaap), and "One (1) school director for a three-year term, ending March 2028, who resides in the Town of Montgomery" (Mary Niles) -- residency seats, district-wide electorate (modified at-large). The 2024 warning (FNESU Annual Report 2023-2024) is in the same form.

FNESU Annual Report 2023-2024 (official): "NMV UUSD School Directors" -- Niles (Chair, Montgomery), Norris (Vice Chair, Sheldon), Paquette (Clerk, Bakersfield), Dziedzic (Berkshire), Barnard (Montgomery), Hango (Berkshire), Johnson (Sheldon), O'Rourke (Bakersfield) -- 8 directors, 2 per town. As updated by the 2025 ballot above: Shea holds the Bakersfield seat O'Rourke held, and Schaap the Montgomery remainder seat Barnard held. FLAG: the March 3, 2026 winners for the three 2026-expiring seats and the Articles of Agreement were not fetched (missing: the FNESU Annual Report 2025-2026; the March 3, 2026 ballot/results). No departures are recorded for Barnard or O'Rourke -- their exits are documented only by their seats' re-election.
